scope: CPU review of generated layer-1 residual/norm1 source and selected schedules; no new GPU execution
rounding_contract: Generated source accumulates squared unrounded residual values, stores the residual to FP16, then reloads FP16 for normalization. Physical block_x alone is not the full statistics input. Prior layer FFN h/out match on all eight tiles; scale and norm weights are shared.
interpretation: Different selected reduction schedules can change FP32 summation order. Source inspection alone does not quantify throughput or prove every final RGB difference has this single cause.
